concerns.text: T003 (Checksums) is listed as [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on the successful completion of T001 and T002 (downloads). A checksum cannot be verified before the file exists. T003 must be ordered AFTER T001 and T002, and the [P] tag must be removed.

T004 (Pairing) and T005 (Abort check) are listed as [US1] but lack explicit dependency markers on T003. The data flow requires T003 (verification) to complete before T004 (pairing) can safely process the files. The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section mentions Phase 0 completion but does not explicitly enforce T003 -> T004 ordering within the task list.

T021 (CI resource monitoring) is placed in 'Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)' but depends on the pipeline execution flow described in Phase 5 (T052). A timer started in Phase 2 before data download (Phase 0) will incorrectly count download time or fail to track the 'total CPU time' across the entire pipeline as required by FR-008. The timer logic must be moved to the main entry point (Phase 5 or a dedicated 'Main' phase) to track cumulative time.

T045 (Ridge Regression) is marked as NOT parallel ([P] removed) correctly, but T044 (Outer split) is not explicitly marked as a hard prerequisite in the task description text, only implied. T045 explicitly states 'Input: Fold indices from T044', but the ordering block should explicitly state 'T044 MUST precede T045' to prevent parallel execution attempts by the engine.

T055 (Cross-species model) depends on T036 (z-score) and T037 (ComBat). While T055 mentions 'Input: Data after T036/T037', the task list does not explicitly enforce that T036 and T037 must complete before T055 starts. If T055 is attempted before batch correction, the model will be trained on uncorrected data, violating FR-010.

T064 and T064b are nearly identical (Commit/Tag vs Tag). While not a strict ordering violation, this redundancy creates ambiguity in the execution order for the final release step. T064b should be merged into T064 to ensure a single, clear 'Release' task at the end of the pipeline.
